Ultracode is a multi-agent team with verification, better for audits, comprehensive reviews, code migration, and research where coverage and cross-validation matter more than depth. title: 马斯克，要颠覆EUV光刻机？
content: A Chinese article speculates Elon Musk may pursue Free Electron Laser (FEL) technology to disrupt EUV lithography monopolies, citing his response to TeraFab's plans. FEL uses particle accelerators and undulators to produce tunable, high-power coherent light with superior efficiency and adjustable wavelengths versus ASML's fixed 13.5 nm LPP EUV sources. Startup xLight, chaired by former Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger, pursues this approach, claiming 4x power output and 50% lower wafer costs. However, FEL systems require massive infrastructure, and despite superior physical characteristics, engineering challenges around stability, optics integration, and cost remain unresolved for semiconductor mass production.

title: OpenAI用1年时间证明，你并不用为AI换浏览器
content: OpenAI shut down its AI-native browser Atlas in August 2026 after just 292 days, joining a wave of failed AI browser ventures including Arc, Sidekick, and The Browser Company. Despite initial hype as a "Chrome killer," Atlas never expanded beyond macOS and attracted minimal users. Established browsers like Chrome retained two-thirds global market share throughout. Giants like Google and Microsoft quickly integrated AI features directly into existing browsers, removing any competitive window. title: 张一鸣为什么反对蒸馏？
content: ByteDance founder Zhang Yimin opposes model distillation—a technique where smaller models learn from larger ones—preferring independent development despite higher costs and risks. At a July internal meeting, he directed Seed team to build foundational capabilities through pre-training, data systems, and engineering rather than leveraging external models. This reflects ByteDance's platform-native philosophy of controlling critical variables internally. The company is now pursuing large-scale model training, integrating resources from Volcano Engine, Doubao, and Feishu while tightening compliance around API usage. This strategic divergence highlights deepening route differentiation among Chinese AI firms beyond mere technical methods.

Apple also continues AI collaboration with Baidu for visual search and upgraded Siri capabilities.

title: 这一次，腾讯想填补国内射击空白

Its core innovation is "adaptive cover," allowing dynamic movement across natural terrain rather than static objects. The studio aims to advance cover-shooting mechanics while establishing itself as a new creative force.

title: 特朗普政府将向电池及材料企业拨付 20 亿美元
content: The Trump administration will provide over $2 billion to battery and critical mineral companies to reduce dependence on Chinese suppliers. The Defense Department committed $1.4 billion in loans to Sila Nanotechnologies and signed agreements with three other firms. A dedicated office will oversee fund distribution. The initiative, driven by national security concerns about foreign reliance for military components, will be announced at a Friday roundtable with mining executives focused on expanding domestic battery and metal production. Secretary Rubio is expected to attend.

content: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei predicted in 2025 that a $1 billion one-person company would likely emerge by 2026 in proprietary trading or developer tools. The author, who runs exactly such an AI-powered solo crypto trading infrastructure business from Bali, notes that as of mid-2026, this has not happened.

A user asks about investment guru "阿段" (likely Duan Yongping) regarding news that DeepMind founder Hassabis considered leaving Google, reportedly stayed due to management concerns about stock price drops. The reference to "老巴" (Old Buffett, i.e., Warren Buffett) suggests surprise that even Buffett didn't anticipate this.
